Name: Muyi's ToolBox
Author: MuYi12
Description:
One console, every tool.

Muyi's ToolBox is a single SMAPI mod that keeps growing: every update adds another small cheat or quality-of-life command, so you stop installing a separate mod for every little thing. One hub, one tb away.

Version 1.4 — the Trinket Toolbox & Recipe Tooltips

Unlock your trinket slot instantly with trinket unlock — it flips the exact same switch the game's own Combat Mastery flips. No all-skills grind, no Mastery Cave run. Just you, the slot, and a lot more trinkets to test.

And now: point at any item and instantly see everything you can craft with it. The recipe tooltip reads the game's live recipe data — base game and mod-added recipes alike — shows what you can craft right now (materials in your inventory) and what's still out of reach, sorted so the craftable ones float to the top. Scroll through long lists right on the tooltip.

Coming next: item spawning, skill controls, time & weather — and whatever you ask for. Requests are the real engine of this box: if something in your game feels tedious, or you're surprised a little cheat doesn't exist yet, drop it in the comments or the Posts tab. No request is too small or too weird. I read every one, the best ideas become commands, and whoever suggested them gets a shout-out in the patch notes.

Installation

- Install SMAPI (4.0.0 or later).
- Unzip the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
- Launch the game with SMAPI, load a save, and type tb in the SMAPI console — that's the whole tutorial.

Main features

- tb — the toolbox index: lists every command the box can do today.
- trinket unlock — unlock the trinket slot (same stat the vanilla Combat Mastery grants), works on any save.
- trinket status — check your trinket slots and mastery experience at a glance.
- recipes on/off & recipes status — toggle and inspect the recipe tooltip engine.
- Recipe tooltip on hover — see every recipe an item is used in, live from game data (mod-added recipes included); craftable entries highlighted, dim entries mean you're missing materials; scroll the list with the mouse wheel.
- Zero menu clutter: everything lives in the console; the hover tooltip is the only thing that ever appears on your screen, and only where vanilla tooltips already do.
- Roadmap: item & skill tools, time and weather controls, and more every update.

Requirements

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0.0+
- Works in single player and multiplayer (commands affect your own farmer).

Shout outs

Thanks to ConcernedApe for the game and its wonderfully hackable 1.6 update, and to the SMAPI team for the modding framework this box is built on.

You — request a command in the comments or the Posts tab; if it makes the toolbox better, it ships.
